- Strong analytical and structured thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative data into clear insights and actionable recommendations

Lead high-impact transformation initiatives for Moody's Analytics by partnering with senior stakeholders across the enterprise to identify, prioritize, and deliver sustainable value.

- Clearly frame current state challenges by synthesizing complex quantitative and qualitative data to distill the need for change
- Articulate option sets and recommendations for a path forward, weighing impact, effort, and timelines to inform decision-making
- Assemble and coordinate cross-functional teams, building consensus and ensuring accountability across a diverse set of technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Translate content and recommendations into compelling presentations for C-suite and Board-level audiences
- Facilitate executive-level workshops and meetings to align stakeholders and secure senior leadership buy-in across the organization
- Design target operating models, including governance structures, process design, and review cadences
- Conduct stakeholder roadshows to socialize changes and disseminate best practices across the enterprise
- Monitor initiative performance and adoption against defined success measures, partnering with business owners to ensure recommendations translate into sustained outcomes
- Develop and maintain project plans to drive progress and escalate potential blockers in a timely manner

MA Business Transformation acts as internal management consultants, partnering closely with cross-functional leadership to ensure cohesive design and execution of the firm's most pressing internal priorities. - Demonstrated experience in a solutions architecture, pre-sales engineering, product sales specialist or technical consulting role within financial services or a technology vendor serving the banking sector
- Strong foundation in software architecture, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise data integration patterns
- Strong understanding of commercial lending processes — including but not limited to loan origination, pre-screening, credit assessment workflows, financial spreading, covenant management, early warning and portfolio monitoring
- Working knowledge of GenAI and large language model (LLM) applications in enterprise settings, including an understanding of model governance, AI explainability, and responsible deployment in regulated environments
- Familiarity with Australia's AML/CTF compliance framework. Proficiency in data analytics tools and languages such as Python, SQL, or equivalent platforms used for data manipulation and analysis
- An understanding of the Australian prudential regulatory landscape, including how APRA's standards influence technology, data, and risk management decisions within ADIs
- Basic understanding of artificial intelligence concepts, with curiosity and enthusiasm for learning how AI tools can be used to improve processes and drive efficiency. Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use

Education
- Bachelor’s degree

Responsibilities
The Solutions Specialist is an embedded technical and commercial resource within the FI sales team — not a back-office engineering function. This role exists to bridge the gap between complex client problems and Moody's product capabilities, translating institutional requirements into solution designs that are commercially viable and technically sound.
You will operate across the full breadth of Moody's Analytics offering, including lending technology, credit risk modelling, KYC/AML compliance, data and analytics platforms, and sustainability risk quantification. This is an executive-facing position. You will engage with C-suite and senior leadership team - articulating how Moody's integrated platform creates measurable business value. You must be as credible in a boardroom strategy discussion as you are in a technical deep dive with a client's engineering team.
The role requires someone who can co-own pipeline generation, qualify opportunities, shape deal strategy, articulate return on investment, and contribute meaningfully to enterprise sales cycles with Australia's most significant financial institutions.
- Design and present end-to-end solution architectures that address client requirements across lending, credit risk, compliance, and data analytics — tailored to each institution's technology landscape and regulatory obligations
- Lead technical product demonstrations, proof-of-concept builds, and solution workshops for prospective and existing clients, ensuring alignment between Moody's capabilities and stated business outcomes
- Partner with relationship managers throughout the sales cycle to qualify opportunities, shape deal strategy, and develop commercially compelling proposals and RFP responses
- Engage directly with senior stakeholders — including CTOs, CROs, Chief Data Officers, and heads of lending — to articulate Moody's value proposition with technical precision and commercial relevance
- Translate complex technical concepts — such as GenAI-powered credit memo generation, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and agentic workflow automation — into language that resonates with both technical and non-technical audiences
- Advise clients on integration architecture, including API connectivity, data ingestion patterns, and interoperability with core banking and enterprise data platforms
- Maintain current, working knowledge of Moody's product suite, including CreditLens (loan origination and covenant management), credit scoring and stress-testing models, KYC/AML orchestration tools, and climate risk analytics
- Contribute to market intelligence by feeding client insights, competitive positioning, and emerging technology trends back into the broader sales and product organization
- Support the development of pre-sales collateral, including technical briefs, solution diagrams, and demonstration environments that accelerate deal progression

About the Team
The Financial Institutions (FI) team in Australia and New Zealand operates as a consultative sales organization, covering the full spectrum of the banking sector. The team comprises high-performing relationship managers who combine deep product knowledge with a rigorous, data-driven approach to client engagement. Every member of the team is expected to understand how Moody's solutions map to institutional priorities — from credit origination and portfolio risk through to regulatory compliance and climate analytics.

jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

Skills and Competencies
- 12+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, or equity research, including 5+ years leading teams, with a track record of interpreting enterprise-level P&L performance and drivers
- A player-coach mindset, with the ability to build models, work directly with data, and produce polished deliverables while leading a team and setting strategic direction
- Deep expertise in consolidated P&L management, scenario planning, financial modeling, and cash-flow forecasting, plus incentive compensation and performance-funding mechanics
- Exceptional communication skills at all levels, with the ability to present confidently to senior leadership
- Proven ability to lead through complexity and competing priorities with strong independent judgment, attention to detail, and a bias toward automation
- Demonstrated fluency with AI/GenAI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude) applied to real finance workflows, Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; working knowledge of EPM platforms (e.g., OneStream) and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Microsoft Fabric) strongly preferred
- Experience in a public, global, multi-segment organization; direct exposure to executive and Board reporting and earnings-related analysis; and a track record of leading finance transformation, systems implementation, or AI/automation initiatives preferred

Education
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field required; MBA, CPA, or CFA preferred

Responsibilities
The VP, Corporate FP&A leads enterprise-wide planning, forecasting, reporting, and analysis across Moody's.
- Own end-to-end consolidation of the enterprise P&L across the annual operating plan, rolling forecast, and five-year strategic plan, ensuring coherence across all segments and functions
- Build, review, and stress-test complex financial models, and direct scenario, sensitivity, and bridge analysis that gives leadership actionable insight into drivers, risks, and opportunities
- Produce and elevate executive reporting — including monthly and quarterly financial reviews and quarterly Board decks — translating complex outcomes into concise, decision-ready narratives
- Partner with Investor Relations on earnings preparation and the roadmap for evolving external reporting, including analysis on reported and organic basis
- Oversee enterprise incentive compensation funding analysis, including performance-based calculations and scenario modeling across plan designs, and prepare Compensation and Human Resources Committee materials
- Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing, globally distributed FP&A team, driving capability building, workforce planning, and a culture of ownership
- Advise segment and functional leaders on investment, resource-allocation, and margin-expansion decisions, and support mergers and acquisitions integration, restructuring programs, and topline growth initiatives

About the Team
Our Corporate Financial Planning and Analysis team leads enterprise financial planning, analysis, and performance management across Moody's. We provide strategic financial insights that support executive decision making and drive long-term growth, integrating FP&A, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, People, and Investor Relations to ensure plans, forecasts, and earnings narratives accurately reflect business performance across Moody's Ratings, Moody's Analytics, and Shared Services. By joining our team, you will contribute to high-impact work spanning Board and management reporting, earnings support, incentive compensation governance, and AI-enabled finance transformation at one of the world's leading financial intelligence organizations.
